conditions.evidence: expertise in anal cancer diagnosis and treatment
conditions.label: anal cancer

modalities.evidence: multi-parametric Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) of the pelvis
informs the planning of radiotherapy treatment

output.population: An expert panel of radiologists and radiation oncologists with expertise in anal cancer diagnosis and treatment, invited by the Anal Staging Subgroup of the International Rare Cancer Incentive
output.summary: Expert consensus staging work on pre-treatment pelvic imaging for anal cancer, aimed at standardizing tumour and nodal staging to guide radiotherapy planning, radiotherapy atlas development and clinical trial design.
